f.title: Include the study registration date as a milestone in the final report of imposed non-interventional PASS
f.statement: For non-interventional PASS imposed as an obligation, the date of study registration in the electronic study register shall be included as a milestone in the final study report (IR Annex III.3).
f.applicability: Non-interventional PASS imposed as an obligation

rows.quote: According to Annex III.3 (Format of the final study report) of the Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) No 520/2012 (IR), the date of study registration in the electronic study register shall be included as a milestone in the final study report for non-interventional PASS imposed as an obligation.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: Mandatory (shall, IR Annex III.3) correct; passive voice, MAH actor inferred as author of the final study report. Version confirmed current on EMA GVP page (EMA/395730/2012 Rev. 3); no duplicate committed curation.

f.title: Register non-interventional PASS in the EU PAS Register before the study starts
f.statement: Non-interventional PASS should be registered in the EU PAS Register before the study commences or at the earliest possible date.
f.applicability: Non-interventional PASS (per the cross-reference to GVP Module VIII B.2: all non-interventional PASS conducted voluntarily in the EU or included in the agreed EU RMP, as well as imposed PASS)

rows.deadline: Before the study commences or at the earliest possible date
rows.quote: Non-interventional PASS should be registered in the EU PAS Register before the study commences or at the earliest possible date,
rows.review_note: Review: Statement trimmed: the parenthetical scope (voluntary EU PASS or PASS in the agreed EU RMP) comes from the preceding Module VIII B.2 cross-reference sentence, which cannot be quoted without a line-end hyphenated word; moved to applicability. Double-check: Statement matches the quote; Recommended (should) correct. Passive voice, MAH inferred; applicability scope drawn from the preceding Module VIII B.2 cross-reference sentence, not the quote. Version confirmed current.

f.title: Upload protocol, updates, progress reports and study reports to the EU PAS Register
f.statement: The study protocol (and its updates), the progress reports and the study reports of non-interventional PASS should be uploaded in the EU PAS Register.

rows.quote: and the study protocol (and its updates), the progress reports and the study reports should be uploaded in the Register.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: Quote begins mid-sentence ('and the study protocol...') without its lead-in; 'EU PAS Register' and 'non-interventional PASS' supplied from the preceding clause; passive, MAH inferred.

f.title: EU PAS Register upload cannot be the only channel for submitting PASS protocols and reports
f.statement: Uploading the study protocol, progress report(s) and final study report in the EU PAS Register is not a legal obligation; therefore registration of a non-interventional PASS in the EU PAS Register cannot be the only channel for submitting these documents to the national competent authorities and the Agency.

rows.quote: Uploading of the study protocol, the progress report(s) and the final study report in the EU PAS Register is not a legal obligation. Therefore, registration of a non-interventional PASS in the EU PAS Register cannot be the only channel for the submission of these documents to national competent authorities and the Agency.
rows.review_note: Review: Level Mandatory confirmed: the sentence is not a "should" recommendation but a binding consequence of the legal submission duties (DIR Art 107m-107p) - the EU PAS Register is not a legal submission route, so the MAH must still submit the documents through the formal channels. Title and statement re-worded as the MAH action; norm stays Guidance. Double-check: Statement trimmed to the quote (removed the added 'MAH must still submit them through the applicable submission procedures', which is not in the quote). Level Mandatory is a judgement call: the sentence has no shall/must; it is a binding consequence of DIR Art 107n-107p submission duties ('cannot be the only channel'), so kept Mandatory but not auto-publishable. Actor inferred.

f.title: Submit draft protocol, substantially amended protocol and final report of imposed PASS to PRAC/Agency or requesting NCA
f.statement: For non-interventional PASS imposed by an EU competent authority (categories 1 and 2), the draft study protocol, the updated protocol following substantial amendment and the final study report shall be submitted according to the normal procedure to PRAC and the Agency, or to the national competent authority of the requesting Member State if the study is conducted in only one Member State.
f.clause: VIII.Add.I.3. Requirements and recommendations for non-interventional PASS conducted pursuant to an obligation imposed by an EU competent authority
f.applicability: Non-interventional PASS imposed as an obligation (categories 1 and 2)

rows.quote: The draft study protocol, the updated protocol following substantial amendment and the final study report shall be submitted according to the normal procedure to the Pharmacovigilance Risk Assessment Committee (PRAC) and the Agency, or to the national competent authority of the Member State that requested the study if the study is conducted in only one Member State [DIR Art 107n to 107p].
rows.location: VIII.Add.I.3. Requirements and recommendations for non-interventional PASS conducted pursuant to an obligation imposed by an EU competent authority
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: Mandatory (shall, DIR Art 107n-107p) correct; passive voice, MAH actor inferred; category 1/2 scope from the section heading.

f.title: Submit the final report of an imposed PASS within 12 months after end of data collection
f.statement: The final study report of a non-interventional PASS imposed as an obligation shall be submitted within 12 months after the end of data collection.
f.clause: VIII.Add.I.3. Requirements and recommendations for non-interventional PASS conducted pursuant to an obligation imposed by an EU competent authority
f.applicability: Non-interventional PASS imposed as an obligation (categories 1 and 2)

rows.deadline: Within 12 months after the end of data collection
rows.quote: The final study report shall be submitted within 12 months after the end of data collection [DIR Art 107p(1)].
rows.location: VIII.Add.I.3. Requirements and recommendations for non-interventional PASS conducted pursuant to an obligation imposed by an EU competent authority
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: Mandatory (shall, DIR Art 107p(1)) and 12-month deadline from end of data collection correct; passive, MAH inferred; 'imposed' scope comes from the section heading, not the quote.

f.title: Submit progress reports of imposed PASS nationally where the NCA requires it
f.statement: The MAH may be required by the national competent authority to submit progress reports to the competent authorities of the Member States in which the study is conducted; all EU/EEA Member States except Denmark, Finland and Norway stated that they require progress reports through national procedures.
f.clause: VIII.Add.I.3. Requirements and recommendations for non-interventional PASS conducted pursuant to an obligation imposed by an EU competent authority
f.applicability: Non-interventional PASS imposed as an obligation conducted in the Member State concerned
f.exceptions: Denmark, Finland and Norway do not require progress reports through national procedures.

rows.quote: The marketing authorisation holder may be required by the national competent authority to submit the progress reports to the competent authorities of the Member States in which the study is conducted [DIR Art 107m(5)]. The national competent authority of the following Member States in which the study is conducted stated that they require submission of the progress reports through national procedures: All EU/EEA Member States except Denmark, Finland and Norway
rows.location: VIII.Add.I.3. Requirements and recommendations for non-interventional PASS conducted pursuant to an obligation imposed by an EU competent authority
rows.review_note: Review: Level Mandatory kept: once the NCA requires progress reports under DIR Art 107m(5) the MAH must comply; applicability reflects the Rev 3 list (all EU/EEA except Denmark, Finland, Norway). Double-check: Level Mandatory is a judgement call: the quote says the MAH 'may be required' by the NCA; the duty is conditional on national requirements. Country list (all EU/EEA except DK, FI, NO) copied correctly from Rev 3.

f.title: Also submit progress reports of imposed PASS to the Agency for centrally authorised products
f.statement: Progress reports of non-interventional PASS imposed as an obligation should also be submitted to the Agency for centrally authorised products.
f.clause: VIII.Add.I.3. Requirements and recommendations for non-interventional PASS conducted pursuant to an obligation imposed by an EU competent authority
f.applicability: Imposed non-interventional PASS; centrally authorised products

rows.quote: The progress reports should also be submitted to the Agency for centrally authorised products
rows.location: VIII.Add.I.3. Requirements and recommendations for non-interventional PASS conducted pursuant to an obligation imposed by an EU competent authority
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: Recommended (should) correct; passive voice, MAH inferred; imposed-PASS scope from section heading.

f.title: Submit the final report of a voluntary PASS nationally within 12 months of end of data collection
f.statement: For voluntary non-interventional PASS (category 3 and other voluntary studies), the final study report shall be submitted according to national procedures to the competent authorities of the Member States where the study was conducted within 12 months of the end of data collection.
f.clause: VIII.Add.I.4. Requirements and recommendations for non-interventional PASS conducted voluntarily

rows.deadline: Within 12 months of the end of data collection
rows.quote: The final study report shall be submitted according to national procedures to the competent authorities of the Member States where the study was conducted within 12 months of the end of data collection [DIR Art 107m(6)].
rows.location: VIII.Add.I.4. Requirements and recommendations for non-interventional PASS conducted voluntarily
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: Mandatory (shall, DIR Art 107m(6)) and 12-month deadline correct; passive, MAH inferred; voluntary scope from section heading.

f.title: Submit protocol and progress reports of voluntary PASS where the NCA requires it
f.statement: The MAH may be required by the national competent authority to submit the study protocol and progress reports of a voluntary non-interventional PASS to the competent authorities of the Member States in which the study is conducted; Austria, Bulgaria, Croatia, Czech Republic, France, Germany, Italy, Lithuania, The Netherlands, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia and Spain stated that they require this through national procedures.
f.clause: VIII.Add.I.4. Requirements and recommendations for non-interventional PASS conducted voluntarily
f.applicability: Voluntary non-interventional PASS conducted in the listed Member States

rows.quote: The marketing authorisation holder may be required by the national competent authority to submit the study protocol and the progress reports to the competent authorities of the Member States in which the study is conducted [DIR Art 107m(5)]. The national competent authority of the following Member States in which the study is conducted stated that they require submission of the study protocol and progress reports through national procedures: Austria, Bulgaria, Croatia, Czech Republic, France, Germany, Italy, Lithuania, The Netherlands, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain.
rows.location: VIII.Add.I.4. Requirements and recommendations for non-interventional PASS conducted voluntarily
rows.review_note: Review: Level Mandatory kept on the same basis as 0007 (DIR Art 107m(5)). Double-check: Level Mandatory is a judgement call ('may be required' by the NCA, conditional on national procedures); country list copied correctly.

f.title: Category 3 PASS: also submit progress reports to the Agency for centrally authorised products
f.statement: For studies of category 3, progress reports should also be submitted to the Agency for centrally authorised products.
f.clause: VIII.Add.I.4. Requirements and recommendations for non-interventional PASS conducted voluntarily
f.applicability: Category 3 non-interventional PASS; centrally authorised products

rows.quote: For studies of category 3, progress reports should also be submitted to the Agency for centrally authorised products.
rows.location: VIII.Add.I.4. Requirements and recommendations for non-interventional PASS conducted voluntarily
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: Recommended (should) correct; passive voice, MAH inferred.

f.title: Category 3 PASS: submit the study protocol with the RMP
f.statement: For studies of category 3, the study protocol should also be submitted with the RMP according to GVP Module V.
f.clause: VIII.Add.I.4. Requirements and recommendations for non-interventional PASS conducted voluntarily

rows.quote: For studies of category 3, the study protocol should also be submitted with the RMP according to GVP Module V.
